expand_env_vars_string: expand environment variables in a string using the dollar brace syntax with optional defaults
expand_env_vars_dict: expand environment variables recursively in dictionary values using the dollar brace syntax
expand_env_vars_list: expand environment variables recursively in list items using the dollar brace syntax
expand_env_vars_with_defaults: expand environment variables with fallback default values when the variable is not set
expand_env_vars_allowed: expand only a restricted set of allowed environment variables by name in a string
